notes: Radiofrequency fermionic interferometer using NiZn ferrimagnet, sensitive to axion-electron interaction (electron gyromagnetic ratio used). Sets 90% CL limit on pseudoscalar coupling g_p. Minimum |g_p| = 1.2e-7 at m_a ~ 0.36 neV. The exclusion plot (Fig. 5) spans roughly 1e-11 to 1e-8 eV with |g_p| from ~1e-7 upward, but only the single best-limit value is given numerically in text. The y-axis is labeled |g_p|, the fermion (electron) pseudoscalar coupling, mapped here to AxionElectron since the experiment probes electron spins. | Vision: Figure 5 plots |g_p| (axion pseudoscalar coupling to fermions/electrons in this RF electron-spin interferometer) vs axion mass m_a in eV. Exclusion region (green) sits near g_p~1e-5 to 1e-6 over mass 1e-11 to ~4e-10 eV. Minimum value stated in text: 1.2e-7 at 0.36 neV. DFSZ axion band shown well below at ~1e-21-1e-26. Boundary is noisy/jagged. Coupling labeled g_p (pseudoscalar to electron spins) - mapped to AxionElectron. Confidence moderate due to jagged boundary reading. | Calibration: No calibration needed
